new_measures.axl:cta-wobbles: Count of call-to-action buttons with a wobble animation; page-wide; count.
new_measures.axl:stagger-delay: Delay between consecutive sibling animation-delay values in a staggered sequence; ms.
new_measures.axl:stagger-total-duration: Sum of staggered delays across one sequence; page-wide; ms.
new_measures.axl:staggered-entrances-per-section: Count of staggered entrance sequences within each section; count.
new_measures.axl:exit-to-enter-duration-ratio: Exit animation duration divided by the enter duration of the same element; ratio.
new_measures.axl:flashes-per-second: Maximum number of luminance flashes in any one second of rendered animation; count per second.
new_measures.axl:blink-marquee-elements: Count of blink and marquee elements in the document; count.
new_measures.axl:animation-primitives: Count of distinct animation types (counter, hover-lift, marquee, etc.) running on the page; count.
new_measures.axl:marquees: Count of horizontally scrolling looping text strips on the page; count.
new_measures.axl:count-up-duration: Duration of number count-up animations on the page; ms.
new_measures.axl:scroll-reveals-per-section: Count of scroll-triggered reveal animations within each section; count.
